evidence_type: one-time execution of a preregistered synthetic local comparison
limitations: five independent replicate worlds and six test groups per replicate
CPU time is a common upper bound, not equal compute delivered; stopping granularity is one full-batch update
decision, predictive and logistic objectives have different computational costs
no tree baseline, calibration or operational claims

decision_and_scoring.exact_reference: independent exact solve on realized scenario, post-selection only
decision_and_scoring.plan_score: sum forecast route travel cost + predicted probability * sum contractual penalties for each selected route (one-minute horizon)
primary_metrics: per-scenario regret versus exact realized reference
decision_and_scoring.replicate_analysis: report five replicate test means and paired per-scenario method-minus-logistic objective differences
decision_and_scoring.validator: backend.validator.validate_plan recomputes constraints and objective from realized input

information_boundary.common_random_numbers: all methods receive identical frozen forecast and realized matrices per replicate and identical 18/6/6 group splits
model_features: forecast route travel cost / 30 clipped to [0,1]
information_boundary.training_labels: train-only indicator that any stop on route is late in the separately generated realized matrix, irrespective of penalty

decision_focused_vqc.objective: soft exact-cover plan decision loss, temperature 2

methods_and_fixed_budgets.primary_budget: at most 0.25 process CPU seconds per method per replicate, measured via Python process_time; stop only between full-batch optimizer updates, so one update may exceed cap

protocol.purpose: One-time synthetic comparison of decision-focused VQC, predictive-only VQC, and logistic regression on independent new worlds.

scenario_family.generator: independent four-location, three-order, two-vehicle family in this isolated runner; same documented generator shape as V2 but with new fixed seeds
